verdict.rationale: Shopify POS sells and runs payment hardware, so API-based fleet management of readers and terminals is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows no API for registering devices, monitoring device status, or pushing configuration remotely. POS Hub's "built-in device monitoring" is a hardware feature, not a developer API. The POS UI extensions and Admin API access add in-app functionality and do not manage devices, so both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage a fleet of readers and terminals via API — register devices, monitor status, and update configuration remotely
